Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
+1 stealth action.
[aus][pre] (D) Put this card on a ready vampire. Vampires with Auspex get
+1 intercept when attempting to block the vampire with this card. This
vampire can burn this card as an action that costs 1 blood. A vampire can
have only one Soul Painting.
[AUS][PRE] As [aus][pre] above, but all vampires get +1 intercept when
attempting to block this vampire.

Is the "but all vampires get +1 intercept" clause *instead* of "Vampires
with Auspex", or *in addition to*?

i.e. if you play it at superior, do vampires with auspex get +2 total
intercept vs. that vampire (one for having auspex, and one for being "all
vampires")?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Instead. Card text: "but" (not "and").
